# FLX-3712: the held-out error does not hold, so the bundle was not called calibrated

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A calibration is calibrated only when at least one held-out query has a target and every held-out query that has one falls within its tolerance (its own tolerance, or else the calibration block's heldOutTolerance). Otherwise fluxsim calibrate --fit writes the calibration patch and reports each held-out query that missed, with its gap and why, exits with status 1, and writes no bundle at --out. A held-out query that could not be counted, or that has no tolerance to be held to, is a miss. The held-out queries are never fitted: to meet them, change what the fit may move or ask the profiler for a better pinned profile, and run the fit again.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3712
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
